name: dumbbell two arm seated hammer curl on exercise ball
description: Seated on a stability ball, you curl two dumbbells with palms facing each other. It hits the biceps and brachialis while the ball asks your core to stay steady.
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Plant your feet wide for balance and keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders without turning your wrists.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full arm extension.
Keep your chest tall and avoid swinging your torso.
